body:
About the naming `RangeRatings`:
Currently without default theming, this widget only provides span as stars. Also, I was thinking that maybe for a rating, a user will want to use some other icons than stars. (maybe heart, or whatever :))

Also, be aware that there is a wierd behavior that you can see with the e-commerce example : if you clear all filters or click again on a selected rating, the largest one would become the new selected one. That's because I use the Range connector which when no refinement is set, put its value to the largest range possible. 
To avoid that we can compute an extra props that will say if there's refinements or not. Do you have any other ideas ?
